answers.core: for any future 2d isometeric voxel games this is a must have! it could also be useful for normal non isometeric 2d to give the illusion of depth, by making the top floor layer of lets say a building translucent and offset.
answers.workaround: yea, I could and have made a simple workaround where I used 2 tilemaps with one offset by 6 pixels up and switched between them each intended building layer up. so just adding a y offset to the tilemap layer relative to the previous layer should be a piece of cake.

title: Add Tilemap Layer offset for Isometric/2.5D/2D depth uses
